comment: The reason prefixes GET /api/tos/sessions/{id}/bars may emit, and the UI state each maps to. Shared by services/dashboard/routes/tos_bars.py's tests and strategy-builder-ui/src/lib/dashboard/tosBars.ts's tests. Both sides assert this file and both run in CI: the Python side in .github/workflows/test.yml, the TS side in the job named "UI suite (lint + build + tsc + vitest)" in .github/workflows/ui.yml, which is path-gated on strategy-builder-ui/** and tests/fixtures/** and so runs whenever this file changes. Adding a prefix here without a matching barsState branch therefore fails that job instead of landing in the UI as 'unknown'. Kept separate from projection-reasons.json because the two read models fail for different reasons and map to different UI states: this one has a caller-supplied path segment and so can also refuse an id. No reason ever carries a value read from the document, and none carries the rejected session id.
